profileEvidence.summary: Affectionate after a cautious start, Patricia gives a firsthand glimpse of the Shinese, a Pekingese–Shih Tzu cross. Her foster describes her becoming attached after a few days, beginning to play with the household’s small dogs, and sleeping quietly in her pen. She still avoids strangers and sometimes pauses nervously while learning to walk on a leash. She entered rescue from an Alabama hoarding case.
